demoKind: local run of the tool on a development machine (OpenFOAM v2406 in Docker, not the hosted service, no physical flow test)
invocation: kernelcad cfd run docs/demos/cfd-manifold/manifold.kcad.ts (run_cfd via record.ts)

settings.mesh: snappyHexMesh, meshSize medium (14 cells across the 8 mm inlet), 17504 cells
settings.render: kernelcad render --preset publish --background dark 1200x800; frames composed with sharp; ffmpeg libx264 1280x720, 5 frames x 3.5 s

proof.job: pressure drop and flow split of a printed two-way coolant splitter at 0.3 L/min water

evidence.framesInspected: frames at 1.5 s, 5 s, 8.5 s, 12 s and 16 s extracted from demo.mp4 and inspected visually

limits: Local validation and a steady laminar solve. Not a hosted-service run, not a certification, and the part was not printed or flow-tested.
